name: activin A receptor type 1

function.text: ACVR1 encodes activin receptor type-1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in negative regulation of signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
